name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2026-04-10, at wavelengths from 1.34 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
